text:
Maya Rivera: Quick sync — I put together a lightweight customer-facing bootstrap checklist for go-live that focuses on bootstrapping traffic, cache seeding, batching defaults, and a streaming fallback. Wanted feedback before I drop it in the enablement packet. Link: https://confluence.local/r/customer-bootstrap (draft)
Santiago Lopez: Nice. Can we add explicit TTL guidance for ephemeral caches? we saw a tenant lose cold-start perf because their seed keys expired too fast.
Priya Patel: +1 on TTLs. Suggestion: seed TTL = 10m for heavy generate flows, 30s for conversational contexts. Also add recommended eviction policy: LRU with max_entries=10k per-tenant.
Noah Kim: Telemetry hooks we should capture during bootstrap: `bootstrap.start`, `seed.attempt`, `seed.success`, `seed.fail`, `bootstrap.complete`, and `bootstrap.latency.p95`. Those feed renewal-risk flags if bootstrap takes >10m or seed_fail_rate>20%.
Jen O'Neil: We should define the customer-facing language for failures — e.g., "initial response delay" not "cache miss". Customers react better to non-technical phrasing. Also we want an escalation path if bootstrap fails: CS -> Solutions Eng -> Eng oncall.
Carlos M.: Proposed enablement plan: 30m ops run-through with customer + 15m shadow during first 1k requests. Who can be the engineering buddy? @Santiago?
Santiago Lopez: I can shadow first hour if needed. Also we should include a tiny seed set of 12 representative prompts (short, mid, long) the CS team can trigger from the portal to exercise KV, batching, and stream paths.
Maya Rivera: Good call. I'll author "seed_set_v1" with 12 examples and include a curl snippet customers can run. Example to trigger seeds: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/bootstrap \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -d '{"tenant":"acme","seed_set":"seed_set_v1"}'
```
Priya Patel: For batching defaults in the guide: suggest batch_window_ms=20, max_batch_size=64 for chat-style; for high-throughput generation recommend batch_window_ms=50 and max_batch_size=128. Include a note about latency tradeoffs.
Noah Kim: Add a short section on streaming fallback: prefer streaming=true for UX, but if model falls back to non-streaming due to capacity use the `fallback_model` config and emit `fallback.triggered` metric. That reduces user-visible errors.
Maya Rivera: Capture escalation triggers in the doc: bootstrap > 15m, seed_fail_rate > 20%, avg_p95_latency increase > 2x baseline, or telemetry gap > 1m. CS should open a support ticket with logs and attach `bootstrap_id`.
Jen O'Neil: Also include a one-liner renewal signal: if bootstrap succeeded but 7d active rate < 40%, flag for adoption outreach.
onboard-bot: Created page "CS Bootstrap Checklist (v1)" and assigned Maya Rivera for edits. Due in 48h.
Maya Rivera: Thanks — I'll update the draft with the TTLs, seed_set, telemetry hooks, batching presets, streaming fallback text, and the customer-friendly failure wording. Will ping for final review tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
